thread:
sasha: Postmortem uploaded: root cause = route-advert mismatch (shadowed prefix) + low DNS TTL (30s) -> clients re-resolved mid-convergence, caused TLS handshake retries and SNI mismatch errors across regions (ca-central-1 -> eu-central-1). doc: https://redwood-internal/pms/248400.

ryan: saw increased TLS_ERR_RATE at ~02:11 UTC. SYN retransmits and SYN_RECV spikes on LBs. correlates with route publish at 02:09.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-078 created. Auto-suppressed tls-handshake alert while mitigations in flight. :wrench:

net-eng-ana: immediate mitigations we executed: 1) emergency DNS TTL raise to 900s for affected records (owner: net-eng-ana, done at 02:25 UTC) 2) move faulty prefix to quarantine pool so it stops being advertised (owner: paul, done at 02:30 UTC) 3) rollback route publish (owner: ryan, done at 02:32 UTC). metrics improving.

manager-kim: good work. please list follow-ups with owners and timelines so we can track in the postmortem board.

sasha: follow-ups agreed in triage: A) implement route-shadowing check in publisher to reject overlaps unless explicit override (owner: paul, ETA: 5d, JIRA NET-455) B) add DNS failover policy that enforces TTL floor for global services (owner: net-eng-ana, ETA: 3d, JIRA NET-456) C) add LB conntrack autoscale + alert threshold tuning (owner: ops-paul, ETA: 7d, JIRA INFRA-801) D) add TLS SNI canary broken down by src_region + reflector-id (owner: ryan, ETA: 48h, OBS-240) E) update runbook with explicit "quarantine prefix" steps and rollback checklist (owner: manager-kim, ETA: 4d, JIRA OPS-122).

paul: opened PR for shadowing check: https://git.redwood/routing/PR-501 - includes dry-run and admin-override. reviewers: @ryan @net-eng-ana.

net-eng-ana: DNS TTL emergency validated via dig and resolver traces. will schedule controlled rollout for TTL floor.

ryan: dashboards show TLS_ERR_RATE dropping from 8.3% -> 0.8% within 10 minutes post-rollback. will add per-src-region SNI panel to Grafana.

sre-bot: JIRA tasks created: NET-455, NET-456, INFRA-801, OBS-240, OPS-122.

manager-kim: please update tickets and move items to the networking reliability epic. also propose adding a postmortem checklist entry: "any prefix overlap with live announces?" owner: manager-kim.

paul: will follow up on PR comments today. dry-run shows no false positives in staging.

sasha: I'll post a weekly digest to the routing reliability board with the incident pattern note: "route shadowing + low TTL -> TLS retry storms" and tag recurring-incident. Closing thread for now, will reopen if blockers appear. :white_check_mark:
